en.text: Let's take out the Pigeon Lady.
Let's take out the Chess Player.
Let's take out the Test Pilot.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
I'll be back when I can.
I'm not ready for a team fight.
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Like there was ever any doubt.
How else was this going to end?
We all played our parts to perfection.
Hm, you weren't dead weight after all.
I'd work with you all again.
No need to thank me, I know I'm amazing.
Some of you desperately need a fashion consultant.
Take a look at these losers, they don't have a chance in hell.
I have things to do, people, let's get the show on the road.
How hard can summoning a god be…
Check out what the Venator bought.
My bats will fill the air.
They're going to be running like hell.
My bats will run them down.
Who's ready to see something amazing…
You need to help the Sheriff.
They're not able to stop Abrams.
They took out the Pigeon Lady!
BeBop, you're not useless after all!
Good luck doing whatever a golem does
There goes a walking fashion crime
They took out the Chess Guy!
I like the way you think, Paradox.
They took out the Test Pilot!
Hope that doorman does something useful
Did he notice me? Oh god I think he noticed me
We need to help the Professor.
Maybe teachers aren't totally useless after all.
I was starting to get worried.
I see why Fairfax keeps her around.
Did she notice me? I think she noticed me
Oh my God, I love her.
Ok, maybe Seven's scary after all.
Haze, you belong on the runway.
Someone get that lady some shoes
We make a good team, Infernus.
You're fun to work with, Infernus.
That thing didn't have a chance.
They got to be hating Lash now.
Now there goes a man who knows his place
Looks like someone took their arthritis medication.
Not bad for an old man.
My God, Grey Talon, you're actually useful.
The old man was looking out for us.
Looks like Gray Talon wasn't taking a nap after all.
At least he's hunting them, not me
They took out the Rat King!
He just stabbed a lot of people, didn't he?
That guy spends way too much time on his hair
Stupid Arin with their stupid scarf and their stupid case and their stupid family
No one can actually be that happy all the time…
You know, Ivy, at first I thought you were disgustingly saccharine, but now you're surprisingly useful.
That thing didn't have a chance.
She's odious, but she's good at killing people.
Oh this feels so good on my skin.
I take it all back, the Cube is amazing.
What the hell is that thing
There's more to her than I thought…
She stabbed the hell out of them…
I can't understand a damn thing that lady says
I can't believe I have to deal with these people.
I need to improve my powers.
Can't forget to train my abilities.
I don't like being this exposed.
I'm on my own out here, I need to be careful.
I'll make them pay for this…
I gotta get out of here.
I don't like the way that was going…
This isn't going how I planned.
Hm, I may need a new plan…
This is bad but we can still pull it off.
I'm not going to let those losers beat us.
How did things get this far out of my control?
We don't have time to make more mistakes.
We need to get our shit together.
If we don't turn things around soon we'll be in trouble.
We still have time to stop them…
They were outmatched from the beginning.
I won't let you kill me!
You missed your chance to kill me…
Put me down you goddamn redneck!
Oh my God, this Ixian won't die.
Can you please just stand there and die?
Help me kill this stupid Detective.
That's the best you got, Paradox?
Thought she'd be harder to kill than that.
Look out for the black hole.
Be ready for a black hole.
I'll smash every one of her machines.
I'm gonna kill Fairfax's little pet genius.
We need to plan a defense!
Be careful, they got they Rejuv.
Where do you think you're going, Haze?
I love playing hide and seek.
You thought you were safe in the skies?
I can get to you whenever I want, Vindicta...
Maybe next time you'll be good at your job, Infernus.
You were never going to pull that off, Infernus.
Well that was a sad getaway.
Get your filthy paws off me!
Can someone shoot this goddamn mole?!
I thought you were supposed to be competent, Lash.
I'll be running New York in no time…
Oh look, I'm great. Surprise surprise.
Only way this was going to end.
They didn’t have a chance against me.
Why are you hiding, I was having fun…
The longer you hide the worse it's going to be for you…
Just come out and die and save us all some time.
You think I'd let that happen?
No one stops me from getting what I want.
Blah blah Macomb massacre blah blah.
Took care of the Midwest hayseed.
Don't think Abrams will underestimate me again.
Aww. I though he was supposed to be tough.
What chance did and automaton have against me?
"Oh, I wanna save Miss Shelly so she doesn’t die," whatever.
Arthur dies at the end. Yeah, I read it, don’t act surprised.
She would have been eaten alive at Eastside.
Why couldn't she have brought Dickens or some other boring shit?
What was she going to do? Chaucer me to death?
You know, there was a time when Paradox was actually relevant.
She thought she was so smart.
Hey, I killed the Time Thief.
The Doorman's dead, it was easy.
Of course they left it to me to kill the cosmic being.
Just so you know, that hat makes you look stupid.
Get that thing away from me.
Never seen a vampire like him before.
There's only room for one predator of the night.
Sure he was a vampire, but he was a shitty vampire, so it's ok.
Word of advice, Dynamo, burn the jacket.
I can only imagine having to sit through his lectures.
You are not very good at this, are you, Professor?
The best help their patron could find was a college professor? Oh man, they're screwed.
We don't need to be scared of the Professor.
The only acceptable time for a pillow fight is a photoshoot, and even that's tacky.
You're not at my level, Apollo.
I expected better of you, Apollo.
Hate to do that to a fellow Blackmore alumni.
Some genius she turned out to be.
If I cared enough about science, went to engineering school, and actually applied myself.. I could've been you.
"I'm a genius," nah bitch, you're dead.
I don’t get why people think she's a big deal.
He'll model for me one day.
He looked so sad, oh well, who cares.
I hate killing a man who can pull off leather pants…
So now that you know you're going to lose, do you think your name's ironic or just tragic?
I don't care that she tried to kill me, Lady Geist is amazing.
Now hopefully I impressed her with my ruthlessness.
Well that might have killed my chances of dressing her for the Met gala.
He smelled like a dirty subway tunnel.
Oh my God, would it kill you to put on real pants? A shirt, a jacket, anything?
I think he was creepier than Espina.
I don't get why people are so scared of the world's tackiest lamp.
Seven's dead. No big deal. You're welcome.
Ok. So sandmen are as scary as people say.
She was making that uniform work.
I'm not worried about the OSIC, vampires are a protected species.
Haze, you may walk through dreams, but I own the night.
I know how to deal with rich assholes.
What lame costume party did she walk out of?
You tried to assassinate me? Who do I look like? Arin Fairfax?
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Vindicta.
You should've stayed behind the bar where you belonged.
That's for carding me on my 16th birthday.
Your stupid little bar is going to close, and there is nothing that you can do about it.
Being killed by me is probably the highlight of your miserable life.
I thought that guy was supposed to be a big deal.
You make walking corpses look bad, Kelvin.
You know, Kelvin, maybe if you stopped underestimating people, your whole expedition wouldn’t have died in the arctic.
I'm pretty sure those were the guys selling knockoffs of my dresses.
I get why Sandra thinks he's hot.
I was expecting more from you, Lash.
I'm not some grubby pit fighter, Lash, I'm a real talent.
Well he wasn't lacking in confidence. Skill yes, but confidence, no.
Magic tricks are stupid and I'm glad you're dead.
I'm glad those two losers weren't on my team.
To think there was a time where the Sinclair's were actually relevant.
We get it, you like the Djinn.
You'd think an ambassador would have a better personal assistant.
You don't have to yell everything, Jesus.
A shame, in another life, you could've been my cool aunt or something.
I'd rather die than become a creepy cat lady.
Oh my God, I think that cat was her only friend, that is so sad.
If you had to have a cat, why'd you pick a sphinx?
Oh look, the weird little goth kid is playing with zombies, I'm shocked.
I wonder if her parents know that their daughter sucks so much.
I'm surprised that he didn’t crumble to dust.
That was one angry old man.
Aww, you stumbled out of hospice just to die here.
Your grandkids are dead, I get it, go buy a dog.
His old man smell will haunt me.
You think I was going to just let you hunt me?
You're just a man, Rourke, and you're gonna die screaming like one.
I won’t be hunted by the likes of you.
Ahhhh, I hope I didn’t get rabies.
He was not a very nice person.
You're angry, we get it, get a hobby.
Bye Billy, no one will miss you.
Man, the Baxter Society must be falling on hard times if he's working for them…
Oh, a bad boy. How original.
He thought he was so cool, didn’t he?
*Sigh* Get with the times, Shiv. Stabbing people was so three years ago.
"I'm the savior of Spanish Harlem," No, you’re a dumb gargoyle and you're dead.
No one likes you, Ivy, they're just pretending.
Tell you what, Ivy, if you ask nicely, I'll let you carry my purse.
She's weird, but she has a look about her.
God, I bet she tastes delicious.
I wanna feed on a unicorn so bad.
I bet her blood tastes like cotton candy and peppermint ice cream.
The tattoos are ugly as sin, but the hair is great.
Oh my God, you are the most disgusting woman I've ever met.
I could not kill that woman fast enough.
I loathe everything about you, Vyper.
I hate your stupid face, I hate your stupid attitude, and I hate your stupid Midwest accent.
Oh my God, he was made of goo.
He's like if saltwater taffy grew arms and legs.
That goo better not stain my jacket.
I've seen vampire elders with a smaller stick up their ass.
That guy's gotta work through some mommy and daddy issues.
Yeah, I don’t get why people are scared of him.
Course I killed Warden, I'm me.
Well she was a total bitch.
Yeah, she has money, but it's new money, so it's like, "Eeh."
Credit where credit is due, her hat was pretty great.
You shouldn’t try to rise above your station, Wraith.
Some queen bee she turned out to be.
Looks like she was all hype.
Who would've guessed the woman swinging an antique didn't survive?
Yamato's dead, which isn't surprising, cause she was fighting me.
I don't get why people are scared of her.
You lost, Yamato, deal with it.
I will sit on a throne of your broken bodies.
Not even the Viscount could stop me.
Think the Vampire Nation is taking note now?
Soon the barony of New York will belong to me.
My power is only getting stronger… give up and save us all some time.
You are all bearing witness to perfection.
Trust me, the longer this goes on the worse it's going to get for you.
No one stands between me and my destiny.
It's ok, I'm used to high pressure situations.
I'll hold on as long as I can.
Well, the help is all dead, that's awesome.
I can't let them finish this without me.
I need to get back out there.
And now we complete the ritual.
This is the beginning of the end.
Time to end things once and for all.
When I'm Viscount, I'll lift The Venery on you.
It's not kind, it's practical. You're just gonna ignore it anyway, and it would make me look weak.
Everyone in the Barony of New York knows who you are.
Because if you're old enough to call The Viscount by his first name you're probably strong enough to tear me in half.
That doesn't make it any less heinous. After the ritual I'm getting you something tailored.
If killing a bunch of people and summoning the patron isn't working for it I don't know what is.
Because I want to say I made a bespoke jacket for a legend.
We should talk. After the ritual I'm going to be Viscount.
Well he's about to become obsolete.
You have a problem with that?
I'm sure you're self conscious about the whole corpse thing, but I bet if you were in a dimly lit club you'd be a Midwest 8, New York 6.
Whoever stitched you up did a shit job.
Of course I could do it better.
I'm not, I'm someone who actually knows how to sew.
You walk one of my shows then sure.
I don't hate working with you.
Listen old man, you try to stake me and I'll rip out your throat.
Fine. Just try not to suck.
So you're the big scary vampire hunter.
You can't speak to me like that
Of course we haven't met I try not to talk to poor people.
Abrams, do whatever I tell you and we'll get along just fine.
Not your boss, just your better.
You smell like garbage and motor oil.
Well Miss Shelly is probably poor, so of course she would say that.
Honestly it's kind of lame. Anytime there's a vampire salon, I have to hang out with a bunch of old people.
No no no, you don't skip a salon. Not showing up is seen as a snub, and the only thing worse than a boring old vampire, is an angry vampire.
So what do you do? Throw a boomerang?
Cause you're like an Australian robot or whatever?
Why would she make you sound like that?
I try not to talk to the help.
So what do you plan on doing to help? Holding open a door while I do all the work?
You could have at least changed when you got off of work.
Professor, if your so smart, why are you a teacher instead of making real money?
Oh, so I can be a guest speaker or something like that?
Then stop embarrassing your wife and buy a halfway decent jacket.
Oh, I'm with the loser who got himself caught and executed. This should be fun.
You don't know what you're talking about.
I know how to take care of myself.
I think we're going to make a good team Vindicta
When you're a vampire you learn real quick to respect old people that talk weird.
Oh we're going to pick them apart and there's not a damn thing they can do about it.
I don't know, can you afford it?
That was the boat one, right?
I can't speak for the food, I only drink blood.
Go on, make it all about you.
You should have told me you were alive.
I don't know if that's true.

I don't know: how awkward is working with your fiancé that you thought was dead but it just turns out they faked their death because they suck and hate the free market and anything that vaguely looks like responsibility?
I'm going to be Viscount in about 40 minutes.
I don't need a relationship with you.
I'm rich. You have nothing I want.
I am so sorry. We should be friends.
Great, now I'm going to have to get this dry cleaned…
You really need to respect your betters.
Oh, but I was starting to have fun.
Look who's running home to cry.
I don't know if I can take them all…
Might be time to back up…
You're going to suffer for this.
I don't say no to free money.
I didn't forget what you did…
It's a smaller step forward than I'd like but it's still a step…
Wish I had better help, but what can you do?
If the entire team was made up of me, this would never have happened.
Hard to find good help, isn't it?
The Patron should have assembled more useful pawns for me to use.
This isn't the end of Mina Ha.
Oh if they think they're getting away with this they have another thing coming.
I'll have my revenge soon enough…
I'll bide my time before getting revenge.
I hope I get to work with Lady Geist, she's an icon.
It was either do this or go to a lame vampire salon and let me tell you, I do not plan on putting up with six hours of harpsichord music.
The elders can keep the old world, New York is going to be my playground.
I'm tired of being at the bottom of the vampiric social ladder.
Time to shake up the vampiric hierarchy.
This city could use some new blood.
Summoning the Patrons never looked this good.
Soon I'll be Viscount of New York.
I can get an item to help.
Might want to go by the curiosity shoppe.
The shopkeeper is a little much for me, but his wares are good.
I wonder what I can get now.
Might be time to swing by the store again.
The right item can tip the scales.
I should see what else they're selling at the store.
I have enough souls to get something good.
We're closer to completing the ritual.
So they got some souls, who cares?
I'm not hanging out with those losers.
I have a fashion empire to build.
I have a whole life to build after my parents botched my turning, so no I'm not helping you right now I'm a little busy.
Sorry I'm working on my look book.
I have better things to do with my time than help the Patrons.
If I die I can't go to fashion week, and I'm not risking that.
Can't, I'm busy sucking up to the Viscount today.
I'm sure there's someone out there dumb enough to risk their life.
Go get Vyper to help you, she'll probably do it for a trip to the laundry mat. Ya know, assuming she's not in jail.
I'm flattered but I'm not interested in associating with some of those people.
If they get close they'll regret it.
This should keep the rabble away.
They'll die, I'll live, it'll be fine.
I'm not worried about my health.
If I want their blood I'll take it.
They're going to regret getting close to me.
I hope I don't bend my umbrella beating them to death.
Mom would say I'm lowering myself to their level but whatever, she's not here.
So much better than taking the subway.
Good luck trying to stop me…
They can try to stop me, but it's not going to go well for them.
Oh I am going to be so annoying.
I can't wait to harass them.
I can't wait to fly around Manhattan.
I don't need to be up close to kill someone.
I'll be sure to spread the love.
When the end comes there's nothing they can do about it.
They die when I say they die.
I'm going to kill them all.
I'm coming for every one of them.
I have to be sure to spread this around…
They have no idea what's in store for them.
The umbrella's not just for show.
You ready to stretch your wings darlings?
I can't wait to hear their wings flutter.
This just keeps getting better and better.
The sky will be filled with crimson.
Looking forward to hearing them scream.
It starts slow, but boy does it ramp up…
This is going to be spectacular.
Ready to release the swarm again.
I'm going to take my time with them.
I can't wait for the grand finale…
I'd give up if I were you….
I love hunting in the city.
You have no idea what I'm capable of.
I can't let this effect me…
I don't care about their abilities.
Their magic is too weak to matter…
